*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM MAKE_SET_CODE                                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       This creates the code for evaluating the set statement.   .    *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  STATEMENT_NO   The number of the statement.                    *
*  -->  VARIABLE_NAME  The result variable.                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM make_set_code
            USING
               value(statement_no)
               value(variable_name).
  DATA: form_name(30) TYPE c,
        set_id   TYPE setid,
        settable LIKE gb01-bcltab,
        setfield LIKE gb01-bclfield,
        l_func   TYPE funcname VALUE 'G_VSR_GET_SET_INFO',
        l_ref TYPE  gblfb_tech_name,
        st_text(6) TYPE c VALUE 'G_STEP'.


  READ TABLE pars_formula  INDEX statement_no.

* SETID is stored in the FIELD field
  set_id  = pars_formula-field.   "To avoid compiler errors

* ... Get information about the set .................................. *
  CALL FUNCTION l_func
    EXPORTING
      setid         = set_id
      mandt         = g_mandt
    IMPORTING
      set_field     = setfield
    CHANGING
      set_table     = settable
    EXCEPTIONS
      set_not_found = 1
      OTHERS        = 2.

  CHECK sy-subrc = 0.

  PERFORM blank_line.
  PERFORM t_append_to  USING text-012 variable_name g_code_buf.
  PERFORM append_code USING 0 0 '' g_code_buf.

*                                   NEXT 3 LINES <<<<<<<<< INSERT  83015
  CONCATENATE variable_name '=' 'b_false.' INTO g_code_buf
  SEPARATED BY space.                    " apriori in set cond = false
  PERFORM append_code USING 0 0  g_code_buf 'false before check'.


  IF pars_formula-relat <> 'IN' AND
     pars_formula-tab   <> 'SYST'.
    CONCATENATE  'G_TAB_FLAG-' settable ' = B_TRUE'
                INTO g_code_buf.
    PERFORM m_if USING g_code_buf.
  ELSEIF pars_formula-relat = 'IN'
    AND  pars_formula-tab2   <> 'SYST'.
    CONCATENATE  'G_TAB_FLAG-' pars_formula-tab2 ' = B_TRUE'
                INTO g_code_buf.
    PERFORM m_if USING g_code_buf.
  ENDIF.
* ... Replace all '.' character in the setid ......................... *
  WHILE set_id CA '.'.
    REPLACE '.' WITH '_' INTO set_id.
  ENDWHILE.

  PERFORM e03_create_bool_name(sapfgbba)
              USING
                 be_set
                 set_id
              CHANGING
                 form_name.

  CONCATENATE  form_name '(' g_setspool_main ')'
         INTO g_code_buf.
  CONDENSE g_code_buf NO-GAPS.

  PERFORM
         m_perform
              USING
                 g_code_buf
                 b_false.

  IF setfield <> '*'.           "If it is not a multi set.
    IF NOT ( pars_formula-field2 IS INITIAL ).
      CONCATENATE pars_formula-tab2 '-' pars_formula-field2
            INTO g_code_buf.
      IF NOT ( pars_formula-modifier2 IS INITIAL ).
        CONCATENATE g_code_buf pars_formula-modifier2
        INTO g_code_buf.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
*    Create the field name used in the set.
      CONCATENATE settable '-' setfield
            INTO g_code_buf.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
*    Use the complete contents of the field structure.
    g_code_buf = settable.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM
         m_using
              USING
                 g_code_buf
                 b_true                       "First
                 b_false.                     "Last
  PERFORM
         m_using
              USING
                 variable_name
                 b_false                      "First
                 b_true.                      "Last

* ... Close the IF from the table contents check ..................... *
  IF ( pars_formula-relat <> 'IN'   AND
     pars_formula-tab   <> 'SYST' ) OR
     ( pars_formula-relat = 'IN'   AND
     pars_formula-tab2   <> 'SYST' ).
    PERFORM m_endif.
  ENDIF.
  PERFORM blank_line.
* send result to trace
  IF setfield <> '*'.           "If it is not a multi set.
    l_ref = g_code_buf.
  ELSE.
    l_ref = space.
  ENDIF.
  IF g_line = space.
    PERFORM tr_send_result USING g_multi st_text 'BE_SET'
                             pars_formula-token variable_name l_ref.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM tr_send_result USING g_multi g_line 'BE_SET'
                             pars_formula-token variable_name l_ref.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    "MAKE_SET_CODE

      PERFORM get_exit_form_file
                 USING
                    be_subrule
                    g_exitrule_file.

                               b_notfirst.

  PERFORM blank_line.
  IF g_line = space.

                        form_name variable_name space.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM ADD_RES_DATA                                              *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       This routines generates the code for the data declarations     *
*       RES000 to RESnnn.                                              *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_res_data.

  DATA: BEGIN OF res OCCURS 25,
           res_str(6) TYPE c,
        END OF res,
        last_res LIKE res-res_str,
        list_cnt LIKE d_int VALUE 0.

  PERFORM blank_line.


  LOOP AT solut.

    PERFORM
       get_branch_info
            USING
               solut-id
               solut-sing_mul
               res-res_str.
    READ TABLE res WITH KEY res-res_str BINARY SEARCH.
    CASE sy-subrc.
      WHEN 0.
      WHEN 4.
        INSERT res    INDEX sy-tabix.
        ADD 1 TO list_cnt.
      WHEN 8.
        APPEND res.
        ADD 1 TO list_cnt.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDLOOP.

* If there are no tables then no need to process further.
  IF list_cnt = 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.
* Cosmetic - sort res table so that data is added in right order.
  SORT res.

* Add the first data entry.
  READ TABLE res INDEX 1.              "First element

  PERFORM
     t_append_to
        USING
           res-res_str
           ' LIKE D_BOOL'              "Not a text element because not
                                       "a true language element.
           g_code_buf.
  IF list_cnt = 1.
    PERFORM m_data   USING g_code_buf  b_true  b_true ''.
    EXIT.                              "No need more data   to add
  ELSE.
    PERFORM m_data   USING g_code_buf  b_true  b_false ''.
  ENDIF.

  SUBTRACT 1 FROM list_cnt.            "To avoid adding last item.
  IF list_cnt > 1.
    LOOP AT res    FROM 2 TO list_cnt. "Not first item either.
      PERFORM
         t_append_to
            USING
               res-res_str
               ' LIKE D_BOOL'          "Not a text element because not
                                       "a true language element.
               g_code_buf.
      PERFORM m_data   USING g_code_buf  b_false b_false ''.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
* Now add the last data element.
  ADD 1 TO list_cnt.
  READ TABLE res    INDEX list_cnt.
  PERFORM
     t_append_to
        USING
           res-res_str
           ' LIKE D_BOOL'              "Not a text element because not
                                       "a true language element.
           g_code_buf.
  PERFORM m_data   USING g_code_buf  b_false b_true ''.
ENDFORM.                    "ADD_RES_DATA

*       FORM CONVERT_DATA_TYPE                                         *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Converts the data to the internal representation in ABAP.      *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  TABLE     The table name of the data                           *
*  -->  FIELD     The field name of the data                           *
*  -->  B_WITHLIT If true the string is passed in quotes.  E.g. '12'   *
*                 IF FALSE, WITHOUT THE QUOTEST.           E.G.  12    *
*  <--> DATA_STR  The data to be converted, the data after conversion  *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM convert_data_type
           USING
             value(table)
             value(field)
             value(b_withlit)
             data_str
             l_modifier.

  DATA:BEGIN OF dfies.
          INCLUDE STRUCTURE dfies.
  DATA:END OF dfies.
  DATA: l_data LIKE pars_formula-token,
        c_data_len LIKE dfies-leng VALUE 80, "This is because the
                                             "g_convert functions
                                             "check this value.
        str_len    LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA syntax_error     LIKE sy-tabix VALUE 1.
  DATA l_exit_is_trivial TYPE c.                           "Note 351634
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <f>.



  l_data = data_str.
************************************************************************
* Extract the data string from  the data.  Take care not to lose       *
* internal quote marks (').                                            *
************************************************************************
  IF b_withlit = b_true.
    str_len = strlen( data_str ).
    CHECK str_len > 2.
    SUBTRACT 2 FROM str_len.           "Take account of the delimiters
    ASSIGN l_data+str_len(1) TO <f>.

    SHIFT l_data LEFT.                 "Remove first '
    <f> = space.                       "Remove last  '



  ENDIF.

  data_str = l_data.           "Quotes have been removed.
************************************************************************
* Get the data type                                                    *
************************************************************************
  CALL FUNCTION 'G_FIELD_READ'
    EXPORTING
      fieldname  = field
      table      = table
    IMPORTING
      field_attr = dfies
    EXCEPTIONS
      not_found  = 01.
  CHECK sy-subrc = 0.

************************************************************************
* Perform the conversion.                                              *
************************************************************************
  IF dfies-datatype = 'CURR'.
*   ONLY CONVERT IF THE CURRENCY CODE IS KNOWN.
    PERFORM convert_currency USING
                              l_data
                           CHANGING
                              l_data.
    CLEAR sy-subrc.
*data's and times may have  different internal and external
*representations  although no conversion exit is existing
  ELSEIF dfies-datatype = 'DATS' AND l_modifier IS INITIAL."Note 339361
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERT_DATE_TO_INTERNAL'
      EXPORTING
        date_external            = l_data
        accept_initial_date      = 'X'                      "Note 992335
      IMPORTING
        date_internal            = l_data
      EXCEPTIONS
        date_external_is_invalid = 1
        OTHERS                   = 2.
   IF sy-subrc <> 0 AND l_data <> space.      "Note 317094  "Note 331902
*   No error message if date is in internal format already "Note 317094
     IF l_data(8) CN '0123456789' OR l_data+8(*) <> space.  "Note 317094
       PERFORM append_protocol USING                        "Note 317094
                '3' 'H' '311'                               "Note 317094
                field table space space                     "Note 317094
                syntax_error.                               "Note 317094
     ENDIF.                                                 "Note 317094
   ENDIF.                                                   "Note 317094


  ELSEIF dfies-datatype = 'TIMS'.
    DATA l_tims TYPE t.
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERT_TIME_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        input                     = l_data
      IMPORTING
        output                    = l_tims
      EXCEPTIONS
        plausibility_check_failed = 1
        wrong_format_in_input     = 2
        OTHERS                    = 3.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.    l_data = l_tims. ENDIF.
  ELSE.
  ENDIF.
  syst-subrc = 0.

* 19.11.97 SIMONH
* If a conversion exit and no offset(length) constr. is used make
* the conversion of the constant.
* if the convexit is ALPHA and the offset(length) constr is used do
* no conversion
* in this last case delete the conv. exit name NOW
  IF NOT l_modifier IS INITIAL AND                         "Note 351634
     NOT dfies-convexit IS INITIAL.                        "Note 351634
    PERFORM check_trivial_conversion_exit                  "Note 351634
            USING    dfies-convexit                        "Note 351634
            CHANGING l_exit_is_trivial.                    "Note 351634
    IF l_exit_is_trivial = 'X'.                            "Note 351634
      CLEAR dfies-convexit .                               "Note 351634
    ENDIF.                                                 "Note 351634
  ENDIF.
* if a conv. exit exists (other thean ALPHA) and a offset(length)
* constr. is used, issue a error message.
  IF NOT ( dfies-convexit IS INITIAL ).
    IF l_modifier IS INITIAL.
      CALL FUNCTION 'G_CONVERT_INPUT'
        EXPORTING
          convexit                 = dfies-convexit
          datatype                 = dfies-datatype
          input_value              = l_data
          length                   = dfies-outputlen
        IMPORTING
          converted_value          = l_data
        EXCEPTIONS
          date_does_not_exist      = 01
          date_format_unrecognized = 02
          illegal_length           = 03
          input_is_not_numeric     = 04
          OTHERS                   = 05.
    ELSE.
*          message e309 with field table "Field+offset(length) not
*                  raising not_allowed." allowed due to conversion
      PERFORM append_protocol USING
               '3' 'H' '309'
               field table space space
               syntax_error.

    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    PERFORM append_protocol USING
                 '3' 'H' '311'
                 field table space space
                 syntax_error.
* message e311 with field table raising not_allowed."problems by convert
  ENDIF.

  CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
  data_str = l_data.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  FORM CONVERT_CURRENCY
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  I_VALUE
*  -->  VALUE(O_VALUE)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM convert_currency USING
                          i_value
                      CHANGING
                          value(o_value).
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <curr>, <value>, <output>.
  DATA: br_begin LIKE sy-tabix,
        br_end   LIKE sy-tabix.
  DATA: amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
        field_len LIKE sy-index.
  TABLES: tcurx, tcurc.

  CHECK i_value CS '('. br_begin = sy-fdpos.
  CHECK i_value CS ')'. br_end   = sy-fdpos.
  CHECK br_end > br_begin AND
        br_begin > 0.

*  Write ... currency does not work for long fields.
  DESCRIBE FIELD o_value LENGTH field_len IN CHARACTER MODE.
  IF field_len > 20.
    ASSIGN o_value(20) TO <output>.
  ELSE.
    ASSIGN o_value     TO <output>.
  ENDIF.

*  extract the currency from between the brackets.
  br_end = br_end - br_begin - 1.
  ADD      1 TO   br_begin.
  ASSIGN i_value+br_begin(br_end) TO <curr>.
*  extract the amount before the brackets.
  br_end = br_begin - 1.
  ASSIGN i_value(br_end)        TO <value>.
  amount = <value>.

*  chech if the currency exists
  IF g_mandt IS INITIAL.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM  tcurc
                    WHERE waers       = <curr>.
  ELSE.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM  tcurc CLIENT SPECIFIED
                    WHERE
                           mandt       = g_mandt   AND
                           waers       = <curr>.
  ENDIF.

  IF syst-subrc = 0." the currency exists
    tcurx-currdec = '2'."curr. with no TCURX entry have 2 dec places.
  ELSE."the inputed currency is not existing/mantained
    tcurx-currdec = '9'."no curr. with 9 dec places - no modification
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE * FROM tcurx WHERE currkey = <curr>.

  CASE tcurx-currdec.
    WHEN 0.
      amount = amount / 100.
    WHEN 1.
      amount = amount / 10 .
    WHEN 3.
      amount = amount * 10 .

*  No special treatment for missing entries or 2dec-place entries.
  ENDCASE.

  WRITE amount TO <output> USING EDIT MASK 'RR_______________.__'.
ENDFORM.                    "CONVERT_CURRENCY

*       FORM add_exit_using                                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       The using parameters for an exit are added according to        *
*       the definition.                                                *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  exitname  The name of the exit.                                *
*  -->  filename  The name of the file where the exits are stored.     *
*  -->  fieldname The name of the single field, if the exit requires   *
*                 this parameter.                                      *
*  -->  recname   The name of the record     if this is required by    *
*                 the exit.                                            *
*  -->  b_first   T = First parameter, F = Not the first.              *
*  -->  b_last    T = Last  parameter, F = Not the last .              *
*  <--  b_added   T = Parameter added, F = none added.                 *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM add_exit_using USING value(exitname)
                          value(filename)
                          value(fieldname)
                          value(recname)
                          value(b_first)
                          value(b_last)
                    CHANGING
                          b_added.

  DATA: BEGIN OF exit_lst OCCURS 50,
            name        LIKE gb922-exitsubst,
            param       LIKE c_exit_param_none,
            title(60)   TYPE c,
        END OF exit_lst.

  DATA: exit_key LIKE exit_lst-name,
        t_tadir  LIKE tadir.
  b_added = b_false.

************************************************************************
* Find out if the formpool exists to avoid problems in XPRAs           *
************************************************************************
  t_tadir-obj_name = filename.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_TADIR_INTERFACE'
    EXPORTING
      wi_test_modus       = ' '
      wi_tadir_pgmid      = 'R3TR'
      wi_tadir_object     = 'PROG'
      wi_tadir_masterlang = sy-langu
      wi_tadir_obj_name   = t_tadir-obj_name
      wi_read_only        = 'X'
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS =
         01. "Assume the worst, it does not exist.
* Use no parameters no parameters if it does not exist.
  CHECK sy-subrc = 0.

  PERFORM get_exit_titles IN PROGRAM (filename)  TABLES exit_lst.

  exit_key = exitname.         "Copy into key so that length is correct
  READ TABLE exit_lst WITH KEY exit_key.
  CHECK sy-subrc = 0.          "Not found then no parameters.

  CASE exit_lst-param.
    WHEN  c_exit_param_none  .
*         Do nothing.

    WHEN  c_exit_param_field .
      PERFORM m_using USING fieldname b_first b_last.
      b_added = b_true.
    WHEN  c_exit_param_class .
      PERFORM m_using USING recname   b_first b_last.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM check_exit_using                                          *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Finds out the type of exit involved.                           *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  exitname  The name of the exit.                                *
*  -->  be_type   The boolean type (be_subst or be_subrule)            *
*  <--  x_type    '0'=No param, 'F'='Field', 'C'=complete record       *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_exit_using
                      TABLES   list_exits STRUCTURE gble
                      USING    value(exitname)
                               be_type
                               l_w_list
                    CHANGING   x_type
                               poolname
                               l_title.
  STATICS: s_exitrule_file_checked  LIKE d_bool,
           s_exitsubst_file_checked LIKE d_bool.

  DATA: BEGIN OF exit_lst OCCURS 50,
            name        LIKE gb922-exitsubst,
            param       LIKE c_exit_param_none,
            title(60)   TYPE c,
        END OF exit_lst.

  DATA: exit_key         LIKE exit_lst-name,
*    poolname         like sy-repid,         "Pool name
*      syntax_error     like sy-tabix value 1,
        prefix(1)        TYPE c.                "First Character of Exit

* end of data

* Set default value, no parameter
  x_type = '0'.

* Check that the user exit name doesn't violate against name convention
  CONDENSE exitname NO-GAPS.
  IF exitname CN ' ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_'.
    prefix = exitname+sy-fdpos.
    PERFORM append_protocol_only USING
             '2' 'P' '007'
             prefix space space space.
*             syntax_error.
    MESSAGE e007 WITH prefix RAISING invalid_exitname.
  ENDIF.

* First character determines type of exit
  prefix = exitname.

* For standard exits retrieve only the name
  IF prefix = 'S'.                "=> SAP standard exit
    IF g_fi IS INITIAL.
      CALL FUNCTION 'G_VSR_GET_SYSTEM_TYPE'
        IMPORTING
          x_fi   = g_fi
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 0.
    ENDIF.
    IF g_fi = b_true." a FI type system
      IF be_type = be_subst.         "=> substitution
        poolname = c_subsexit_pool.
      ELSE.                            "=> other VSR objects
        poolname = c_ruleexit_pool.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE."no FI type of system, HR --> do they have SAP exits?
      PERFORM append_protocol_only USING
           '2' 'P' '308'
           exitname poolname space space.
      MESSAGE e308 WITH exitname poolname RAISING non_existing_exit.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.

*   Get the name of exit form pool and check existence and correctness
    IF  be_type = be_subst.
* Don't check formpool if already done
      IF  s_exitsubst_file_checked IS INITIAL.

* Get the name has to be retrieved anyway
        IF g_exitsubst_file IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM get_exit_form_file
             USING
              be_subst
             CHANGING
              g_exitsubst_file.
        ENDIF.

        poolname = g_exitsubst_file.

        PERFORM formpool_get_and_check  USING    g_exitsubst_file
                                        CHANGING g_exitsubst_file_exist
                                               s_exitsubst_file_checked.
      ELSE.
        poolname = g_exitsubst_file.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
* Don't check formpool if already done
      IF s_exitrule_file_checked IS INITIAL.

* Get the name has to be retrieved anyway
        IF g_exitrule_file IS INITIAL.
          PERFORM get_exit_form_file
              USING
                be_subrule
                g_exitrule_file.
        ENDIF.
        poolname = g_exitrule_file.

        PERFORM formpool_get_and_check  USING   g_exitrule_file
                                      CHANGING g_exitrule_file_exist
                                                s_exitrule_file_checked.
      ELSE.
        poolname = g_exitrule_file.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM get_exit_titles IN PROGRAM (poolname)
                    TABLES exit_lst IF FOUND.

  exit_key = exitname.         "Copy into key so that length is correct
* fill the exits list if required
  IF l_w_list = 'X'."is it required?
    LOOP AT exit_lst.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING exit_lst TO list_exits.
      APPEND list_exits.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
  READ TABLE exit_lst WITH KEY exit_key.
  IF   sy-subrc <> 0 AND l_w_list IS INITIAL."=> Exit NOT found => ERROR
    PERFORM append_protocol_only USING
             '2' 'P' '308'
             exitname poolname space space.
    MESSAGE e308 WITH exitname poolname RAISING non_existing_exit.
*             syntax_error.
  ELSE.
    l_title = exit_lst-title.
*   Determine type of parameter
    CASE exit_lst-param.
      WHEN  c_exit_param_none.
        x_type = '0'.
      WHEN  c_exit_param_field.
        x_type = 'F'.
      WHEN  c_exit_param_class .
        x_type = 'C'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    "CHECK_EXIT_USING



*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM APPEND_PROTOCOL                                          *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Fill the protocol ITAB and call the FB to store the message   *
*       in the protocol.                                              *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  AP_LEVEL     protocol level                                   *
*  -->  AP_SEVER     error severity(' ',W(arning) etc.)               *
*  -->  AP_MSGNR     Message-Nummer                                   *
*  -->  AP_VAR1      Message-Variable 1                               *
*  -->  AP_VAR2      Message-Variable 2                               *
*  -->  AP_VAR3      Message-Variable 3                               *
*  -->  AP_VAR4      Message-Variable 4                               *
*  -->  AP_EXCEPTION Exception to be raised                           *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM append_protocol USING ap_level ap_sever ap_msgnr
                           ap_var1  ap_var2  ap_var3  ap_var4
                           ap_exception.

  DATA: protocol LIKE sprot_u OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA l_msg_ty LIKE syst-msgty.
  DATA:        l_obj_name          LIKE gb90-boolid,
               l_obj_step          LIKE gb931-valseqnr,
               l_msg_no            LIKE gb931-valmsg.

  l_msg_ty = ap_sever.
* ... is it an xpra that's runing?
  IF g_xpra = 'X'.         "THAN ...
* ... Fill protocol interface ........................................ *
    CLEAR protocol.

    protocol-level    = ap_level.
    IF ap_sever = 'H'.  "special case 'new' errors
* REACTION: if protocol active append a protocoll warning line
*           if message store possible, store a message with info
* IN BOTH CASES 'OLD' CODING (I.E. WITH ERROR ) SHOULD BE GENERATED
* WITHOUT TAKING THE ERROR IN CONSIDERATION
* AN ERROR MESSAGE SHOULD BE ISSUED IN MANTAINANCE
*
*and no protocol).
* For the other messageseverities (i.e. ap_sever = ISWEA) the
*system:
*       - appends protocol if one exists AND AFTERWARDS IT GOES IT'S
*                                        NORMAL WAY !!!!!!
*       - it issues a message which is caught in in make_boool_form
*       and a  error is written in generated coding or is directly
*        issued in mantainance
      protocol-severity = 'W'.  " protocol severity = warning
    ELSE.
      protocol-severity = ap_sever.
    ENDIF.
    protocol-langu    = 'E'.
    protocol-ag       = 'GB'.
    protocol-msgnr    = ap_msgnr.
    protocol-newobj   = space.
    protocol-var1     = ap_var1.
    protocol-var2     = ap_var2.
    protocol-var3     = ap_var3.
    protocol-var4     = ap_var4.

    APPEND protocol.
* ... Try to append message to protocol .............................. *
    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_APPEND_LOG'
      TABLES
        xmsg           = protocol
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_not_found = 1
        wrong_call     = 2
        OTHERS         = 3.

  ELSE.               "=>   NOT an xpra calling --> no protocol appended
    CASE ap_exception.      "=> different exceptions are possible
      WHEN 1.
        IF l_msg_ty = 'P' OR l_msg_ty = 'H'.
          l_msg_ty = 'E'.
        ENDIF.
*   if g_en_rep is initial than the 'caller' is a mantainance trans.
        IF g_en_rep IS INITIAL    "pflefe transaction
                          OR ap_sever <> 'H'. "a report but error is old
          MESSAGE ID 'GB'      TYPE l_msg_ty  NUMBER ap_msgnr
                  WITH ap_var1 ap_var2 ap_var3 ap_var4
                  RAISING syntax_error.
        ELSE." the caller is a report and the eror is 'new'
          sy-msgid = 'GB'.
          sy-msgno = ap_msgnr.
          sy-msgty = 'W'.
          sy-msgv1 = ap_var1.
          sy-msgv2 = ap_var2.
          sy-msgv3 = ap_var3.
          sy-msgv4 = ap_var4.
          PERFORM show_syntax_message
                 USING g_object_name
                       g_filename
                 CHANGING l_obj_name
                          l_obj_step
                          l_msg_no.
        ENDIF." not an xpra, mantainance or coding gen. rep.?
    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    "APPEND_PROTOCOL

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM FORMPOOL_GET_AND_CHECK                                   *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Determines the name of the user exit form pool.               *
*       Checks the existence and correctness of a form pool.          *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  P_BE_TYPE            Type of the object (Valid. / Subst.)     *
*  -->  P_WORKING_AREA       Name of the working area for T80x        *
*  <--  P_EXIT_FILE          Name of the user exit form pool          *
*  <--  P_EXIT_FILE_EXIST    Flag whether of not the form pool exist  *
*  <--  P_EXIT_FILE_CHECKED  File has been checked, don't check it    *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM formpool_get_and_check   USING    p_exit_file
                            CHANGING   p_exit_file_exist
                                       p_exit_file_checked.


  DATA: BEGIN OF code_tab OCCURS 0,
            line TYPE  rsmaxline,                                "814142
        END   OF code_tab.

  DATA: syntax_error     LIKE sy-tabix VALUE 1,
        exist_flag(1)    TYPE c,
        error_msg        LIKE t100-msgnr,
        error_line       LIKE sy-tabix,
        error_word(20)   TYPE c,
        object_name      LIKE tadir-obj_name.

* Constants
  DATA: c_program_id LIKE tadir-pgmid  VALUE 'R3TR',
        c_object_id  LIKE tadir-object VALUE 'PROG'.
* end of data

* Check that exit formpool exist
  IF  p_exit_file_exist IS INITIAL.

    object_name = p_exit_file.
    CALL FUNCTION 'CHECK_EXIST'
      EXPORTING
        iv_pgmid             = c_program_id
        iv_object            = c_object_id
        iv_obj_name          = object_name
      IMPORTING
        e_exist              = exist_flag
      EXCEPTIONS
        tr_no_check_function = 1
        OTHERS               = 2.

    IF sy-subrc = 0        AND                  "=> entry exist
       exist_flag = 'X'    AND
       NOT ( p_exit_file IS INITIAL ).
      p_exit_file_exist = b_true.
    ELSE.
      p_exit_file_exist = b_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF  p_exit_file_exist = b_false.   "=> write first to prot.
    PERFORM append_protocol_only USING
             '2' 'P' '303'
             p_exit_file space space space.
*             syntax_error.
    MESSAGE e303 WITH p_exit_file RAISING non_existing_pool.

    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

* Check that the programm has no syntax errors
  IF p_exit_file_checked IS INITIAL.
    READ REPORT p_exit_file INTO code_tab.
    SYNTAX-CHECK FOR code_tab MESSAGE error_msg
                                 LINE error_line
                                 WORD error_word.
    IF sy-subrc = 4.           "=> syntax error detected
      PERFORM append_protocol_only USING
               '2' 'P' '306'
               p_exit_file error_line space space.
      MESSAGE e306 WITH p_exit_file RAISING synt_err_in_pool.
*               syntax_error.
    ELSE.                         "=> everthing OF => don't check again
      p_exit_file_checked = b_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.     "FORMPOOL_GET_AND_CHECK

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

*         --> l_boolid --> the ID of the boolean statement             *
*         <-- l_ok = space = everything is fine                        *

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

form check_formula_special tables   l_formula type GBLFB_FORMULA
                                    l_fld_lst type g_fld_lst
                           using    l_boolid
                           changing l_ok.

data: l_index  like syst-tabix occurs 0 with header line,

      index_t  like syst-tabix,

field-symbols: <f>.
*result is OK at the begining

describe table l_formula lines l_form_length.
check l_form_length > 1.

if g_fi is initial.
    CALL FUNCTION 'G_VSR_GET_SYSTEM_TYPE'
     IMPORTING
       X_FI             = g_fi.
endif.
              .
l_index = 1. append l_index.

loop at l_formula where TOKEN = 'AND'   or
                        TOKEN = 'OR'    or
                        TOKEN = 'NAND'  or
                        TOKEN = 'NOR'   or
                        TOKEN = 'IMPLY' or
                        TOKEN = 'EQUIV'.
  l_index = syst-tabix + 1.
  append l_index.
endloop.
* search the places where the checks take place
loop at l_index.
  index_l = l_index.
     perform get_next_nontr_token  tables   l_formula
                           using    l_form_length
                           changing index_l
                                    token_l
                                    l_ref.
     if token_l(5) = 'FIELD'.
         split l_ref at '-' into l_tab
                                 l_fie.
         index_t = index_l - 1.
       else.
         clear: l_ref, l_tab, l_fie.
         check 1 = 2.
     endif.

  if not index_l is initial.
     clear b_set.
     perform get_next_nontr_token  tables   l_formula
                           using    l_form_length
                           changing index_l
                                    token_l
                                    l_ref2.

     check    tOKEN_l = 'LE'  or TOKEN_l = 'LT'  or TOKEN_l = 'GE'  or
              TOKEN_l = 'GT'  or TOKEN_l = 'NE'  or TOKEN_l = 'EQ'  or
              token_l = 'IN'.
     if l_formula-token = 'IN'.
          check g_fi = b_true.
          b_set = b_true."set
        else.
          b_set = b_false."field comparision_operator literal
     endif.
  endif.
  if not index_l is initial.
     perform get_next_nontr_token  tables   l_formula
                           using    l_form_length
                           changing index_l
                                    token_l
                                    l_ref2.
* index of set or constant
     if not index_l is initial.
        index_m = index_l - 1.
       else.
        index_m = l_form_length.
     endif.
     if b_set = b_true.
           check token_l = 'SET'.
*  check if the set fits l_tab and l_fie
           L_FUNC = 'G_VSR_SETS_F4_AND_CHECK'.
           CALL FUNCTION L_FUNC
                EXPORTING
                     REF         = l_REF
                     REF_NAME    = l_ref2
                     BOOLID      = G_BOOLID
                IMPORTING
                     TECH_NAME   = l_SETID
                     DESCRIPTION = l_DESC.
     if l_setid is initial.
         l_ok = 'X'."problems with the set.
         read table l_formula index index_m.
         l_formula-token = '_ERROR'.
         perform put_message_formula using 'GB' '302' l_ref2 l_ref space
                                   space changing l_formula-text.
         modify l_formula index index_m.
         exit.
     endif.
     elseif b_set = b_false.
       check l_formula-token = 'CONST'.
*  check that after the literal, a logical operator comes
       if not index_l is initial.
         clear b_set.
         perform get_next_nontr_token  tables    l_formula
                                        using    l_form_length
                                     changing    index_l
                                                 token_l
                                                 l_ref3.

         check tOKEN_l = 'AND' or TOKEN_l = 'NAND' or TOKEN_l = 'OR' or
             TOKEN_l = 'NOR' or TOKEN_l = 'IMPLY' or TOKEN_l = 'EQUIV'
             or token_l is initial.
       endif.
*  check if the literal fits l_tab and l_fie
       read table l_fld_lst with key table = l_tab field = l_fie.
       if syst-subrc <> 0.
          l_ok = 'X'.
          read table l_formula index index_t.
          l_formula-token = '_ERROR'.
          perform put_message_formula using 'GB' '025' l_ref space space
                                   space changing l_formula-text.
          modify l_formula index index_t.
          exit.
       endif.
       check  ( not l_fld_lst-convexit is initial and
                    l_fld_lst-convexit <> 'ALPHA' ) or
                    l_fld_lst-datatype = 'NUMC'.
* remove the simple quotation marks
           l_len = strlen( l_ref2 ).
           check l_len > 2.
           l_len = l_len - 2.
           l_val = l_ref2.
           assign l_val+l_len(1) to <f>.
           shift l_val left.
           <f> = space.

           CALL FUNCTION 'G_CONVERT_INPUT'
              EXPORTING
                   CONVEXIT      = l_fld_lst-CONVEXIT
                   DATATYPE      = l_fld_lst-DATATYPE
                   INPUT_VALUE   = l_val
                   LENGTH        = l_fld_lst-OUTPUTLEN
              IMPORTING
                   CONVERTED_VALUE = out_data
              EXCEPTIONS
                   DATE_DOES_NOT_EXIST      = 01
                   DATE_FORMAT_UNRECOGNIZED = 02
                   ILLEGAL_LENGTH           = 03
                   INPUT_IS_NOT_NUMERIC     = 04
                   OTHERS                   = 05.
           if syst-subrc <> 0.
                         l_ok = 'X'."problems with the set.
                         read table l_formula index index_m.
                         perform put_message_formula using
                                 syst-msgid syst-msgno SYST-MSGV1
                                 SYST-MSGV2 SYST-MSGV3 SYST-MSGV4
                                 changing l_formula-text.
                         l_formula-token = '_ERROR'.
                         modify l_formula index index_m.
                         exit.
           endif.
     endif.
  endif.
endloop.

endform.

form get_next_nontr_token  tables   l_formula type GBLFB_FORMULA
                           using    l_length
                           changing l_index
                                    l_token
                                    l_value.

clear: l_token, l_value.
if l_index > l_length.
   clear l_index.
   exit.
endif.

loop at l_formula from l_index.
  if l_formula-token(1) <> '$'.
     l_index = syst-tabix + 1.
     if l_index > l_length.
        clear l_index.
     endif.
     l_token = l_formula-token.
     l_value = l_formula-value.
     exit.
  endif.
endloop.
endform.

form put_message_formula using class number par1 par2 par3 par4
                         changing message.

data: l_bapireturn like bapireturn, l_par1 like syst-msgv1,
      l_par2 like syst-msgv1, l_par3 like syst-msgv1,
      l_par4 like syst-msgv1.
      l_par1 = par1. l_par2 = par2. l_par3 = par3. l_par4 = par4.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BALW_BAPIRETURN_GET'
           EXPORTING
                type                       = 'I'
                cl                         = class
                number                     = number
                PAR1                       = l_par1
                PAR2                       = l_par2
                PAR3                       = l_par3
                PAR4                       = l_par4
           IMPORTING
                BAPIRETURN                 = l_bapireturn
           EXCEPTIONS
                OTHERS                     = 2.

check syst-subrc = 0.
message = l_bapireturn-message.
endform.
